senses.gloss: putting, placing, use of the root שׂוּם.
units: Keth. 46ᵃ אתיא ש׳ ש׳ we draw an analogy between sum (Ex. XXII, 24) and sum (Deut. XXII, 14); Y. ib. IV, 28ᶜ שׂוּמָה.
Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵃ אפילו ש׳ מעכבת even where the Biblical text has the verb sum (‘thou shalt put’), it is an act indispensable to legality.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 150:2">Yalk. Gen. 150</cite> <he>שִׂימַת עין</he>, v. <cite ref="E00929"><he>הֲשָׂמָה</he></cite>.
